statement:
∀ (N K : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ), N < 2^K →
  let M : ℕ := 2^K
  let A := fun (d r : ℕ) => ∑ n ∈ (Finset.range (N+1)).filter (fun n => n % d = r), w n
  let C := fun k : ℕ =>
    let q : ℕ := 2^k
    let D := fun r : ℕ => A (2*q) r - A (2*q) (r+q)
    (q : ℝ) / M * ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q,
      (if (N+2*q-r)%(2*q) < q then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * D r * D ((N+q-r)%q)
  (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N+1), w n * w (N-n)) =
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N+1), w n)^2 / M + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, C k

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0002 · 从逐层反射增量还原指定整数的卷积
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0002 · Recover the convolution at a fixed integer from its reflected increments

brief.zh: 令 M=2^K>N。顶层上两个非零权的整数和必须等于 N，底层为总质量的平方除以 M。N 本身是二次幂时取严格更大的 M。
brief.en: Take M=2^K>N. Two surviving weights on the top level have integer sum N. The bottom level is the mass squared divided by M. The modulus is strictly larger even when N is a power of two.
